newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $264 mln trade gap so far in April.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $264 mln trade gap so far in April.

text.p: Brazil has posted a trade deficit of $264 million so far in April, with exports of $1.911 billion and imports of $2.175 billion, a spokeswoman for the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said Tuesday.
She said the trade gap for the second week of the month was $94 million, after exports for the week of $1.103 billion and imports of $1.197 billion.
The second week of the month had five working days, giving daily average exports of $220.6 million and daily average imports of $239.4 million.
The trade deficit for the year so far stands at $3.322 billion. The trade gap for all of 1996 was $5.539 billion.
